questions.question:
When startup also includes a concrete task, waiting for a menu choice could delay that task.
When should HAI show the menu and wait for a selection?
questions.impact: Defines which startup paths require a user response.

options.label: A
options.text: With no task, show the menu and wait; with a task, show the agents/Activity summary and proceed.

options.label: B
options.text: Always show the menu, while proceeding with any explicit task.

options.label: C
options.text: Always show the menu and wait for a choice before work.

questions.question:
The draft does not define which choices the user can select.
What should the top-level menu choices represent?
questions.impact: Defines the selectable actions and how users reach the appropriate capability.

options.label: A
options.text: Task actions, such as Continue Activity, Work on backlog, Start a task, Agent setup, and Help.

options.label: B
options.text: Registered agents directly, plus Activity actions and Help.

options.label: C
options.text: Task actions and individual registered agents together.

questions.question:
Help appears in the title, but its behavior is unspecified.
What Help should this iteration provide?
questions.impact: Bounds the Help content and its acceptance conditions.

options.label: A
options.text: A short overview at startup, also available again on request.

options.label: C
options.text: A startup overview plus detailed help for each action or agent.
